qe: On the 16th Kartik, the day after Dewali, the Goalas of the Patna district observed which festival by driving their cattle over a pig with its feet tied?
qh: दीवाली के अगले दिन, कार्तिक की 16 तारीख को पटना जिले के गोअला लोग किस पर्व को मनाते थे, जिसमें वे अपने पशुओं को बँधे पैरों वाले सूअर के ऊपर दौड़ाते थे?
e: Patna jile ke Goalas yaani Ahir samuday me pashuon ka bahut mahatva tha, isliye unke ek khaas tyohar me pashu tatha doodh dono shamil hote the. Isi samuday me Kartik sudi 16, yaani Dewali ke agle din, ek anokha parishram manaya jaata tha, jise Gaidarh ya Sohrai ke naam se jaana jaata tha. Iski vidhi is tarah thi - Dewali ki raat ghar me bachi hui saari doolh me chawal ubal kar khir banayi jaati thi tatha woh khir Basawan naam ke dev ko arpit ki jaati thi. Us raat sabhi pashuon ko bina khane ke chhod diya jaata tha; agli subah unke seengh laal rang se range jaate the tatha shareer par laal chhinte lagai jaati thin. Uske baad pashuon ko ek khet me chhoda jaata tha, jahan pehle se ek suar is tarah baandh diya jaata tha ki uske pair aapas me bane hue the; pashu us bechare jaanvar ko kuchal kar tatha seengh maar kar maarte the. Exam point: Goalas 16 Kartik, yaani Dewali ke agle din, Gaidarh ya Sohrai manate the; us raat doolh me ubla chawal yaani khir Basawan dev ko chadha kar pashuon ko bhookha rakha jaata tha; agli subah unke seengh laal rang kar bandhe pairon wale suar ke upar daudaya jaata tha.

qe: The Kurmis of the Patna district worshipped Muhammadan Panch Pir, and the officiating priest of this worship was a man of which caste?
qh: पटना जिले के कुर्मी मुस्लिम पंच पीर की पूजा करते थे, तथा इस पूजा के पुजारी किस जाति के होते थे?
e: Patna jile ke Kurmi samuday ki dharmik manyataon me ek ajeeb tarah ka mila-jula roop dikhta tha. Is samuday ke log ek taraf Hanuman tatha Kali jaise orthodox devi-devtaon ki puja karte the, tatha doosri taraf muhammadan Panch Pir ki bhi puja karte the. Is Panch Pir ki puja me purohit ka kaam Dafali jati ka vyakti karta tha, jo dafali baja kar tatha anya rasm kar ke puja sampann karata tha; yah baat dikhati hai ki us daur ke lok-dharm me Hindu tatha Musalman dono paramparaon ka sampark aam baat thi. Isi samuday me kai tarah ke pret yaani evil spirits tatha deviyon ki puja bhi hoti thi, jinme Goraiya tatha Ram Thakur ke naam pramukh the. Aise mishrit vishwas dikhate hain ki gaon ka dharm shastriy niyamon se zyada ritiyon tatha paramparaon par chalta tha. Exam point: Kurmis Panch Pir ki puja karte the tatha unke purohit Dafali jati ke hote the; isi samuday me Hanuman tatha Kali ke saath Goraiya tatha Ram Thakur jaise prem ki puja bhi hoti thi; ise dekh kar lok-dharm me Hindu tatha Musalman paramparaon ka mila-jula roop saaf hota hai.

qe: Which spirit worshipped in the Patna district was regarded as benevolent, unlike the others?
qh: पटना जिले में पूजी जाने वाली आत्माओं में किसे अन्य की भाँति भयावह नहीं, बल्कि परोपकारी माना जाता था?
e: Patna jile ke Kurmi samuday me pret yaani evil spirits tatha devi-devtaon ki ek lambi suchi pracharit thi. Inme zyadatar aatmaayein bhayavah tatha nuksan pahunchane wali maani jaati thin - jaise Goraiya, jise gaon ke bahar mitti ke tile par puja jaata tha, tatha Ram Thakur, jise bakre ki bali se shaant kiya jaata tha. Lekin ek aatma aisi thi jo pareshan karne wali nahi, balki paropkari maani jaati thi - woh thi Bandi Mai. Isi samuday me Karta naam ki ek aur aatma ki puja hoti thi, jiska koi murti ya drishya nahi tha tatha jiske naam se lagta tha ki yah srishti ko banane wale tatha is brahmand ke rachayita ka roop hai. Aise vishwas dikhate hain ki us daur ke lok-dharm me bhay tatha shraddha dono saath-saath chalte the. Exam point: Kurmi samuday me Bandi Mai ko paropkari yaani benevolent aatma mana jaata tha; Goraiya tatha Ram Thakur jaise pret bhayavah maane jaate the tatha unhe bali se shaant kiya jaata tha; Karta aatma ki koi murti nahi thi aur use srishti ko banane wale ka roop maana jaata tha.

qe: In cases of illness, what did the ojhas do with the spirit they believed to have possessed a person?
qh: बीमारी के मामलों में ओझा, व्यक्ति में घुसी मानी जाने वाली आत्मा का क्या करते थे?
oe: They tied it to a tree
They sent it to a temple
They imprisoned it in a bamboo tube or earthen pot which was burnt or buried
They fed it with rice and milk
oh: वे उसे पेड़ से बाँध देते थे
वे उसे मंदिर भेज देते थे
वे उसे बाँस की पोर या मिट्टी के बर्तन में कैद करके जला या दबा देते थे
e: Patna jile ke gaon me bimari ko aksar pret yaani evil spirit ka kaam maana jaata tha, isliye ilaj ke liye ojha yaani jhaad-phook karne wale ko bulaya jaata tha. Ojha apne ek sahayak pret ki shakti se us pret ko bhagane ka daava karta tha; jab pret shareer se bahar nikalta tha, to ojha use ek chhoti baans ki por ya mitti ke ghade me kaid kar deta tha tatha us por ya ghade ko jala diya jaata tha ya zameen me daba diya jaata tha. Aise vishwas me bhay ke saath-saath lok-dharm ki paramparaon ka prabhav saaf dikhta tha, kyunki aisi manyataon me bimari ko kisi bahari shakti ka parinaam maana jaata tha. Isi kaaran gaon me ojha tatha sayana ka darja bada tha tatha log ilaj ke liye unhi ke paas jaate the. Exam point: bimari ko pret yaani evil spirit ka kaam maana jaata tha tatha ilaj ke liye ojha bulaye jaate the; ojha apne sahayak pret ki shakti se pret ko bhaga kar use baans ki por ya mitti ke ghade me kaid karta tha tatha use jala ya daba diya jaata tha.

qe: Which spirit was most feared as the spirit of a woman who had died in child-birth, and needles were driven into the ground to pacify her?
qh: जिस स्त्री की प्रसव के समय मृत्यु हो गई हो, उसकी आत्मा के रूप में किससे सबसे अधिक भय रखा जाता था, तथा उसे शांत करने के लिए जमीन में सुइयाँ गाड़ी जाती थीं?
e: Gaon ke lok-vishwas me pret yaani evil spirits ki ek alag duniya thi tatha unme sabse zyada bhay Churail ka tha. Churail us stri ki aatma maani jaati thi jiski mrityu prasav yaani bacche ke janm ke samay hui ho. Use shaant karne ke liye zameen me sui yaani needles gaad di jaati thin tatha yah manyata thi ki isse woh ghar-parivar ko pareshan nahi karegi. Isi tarah in vishwaso me yah bhi shamil tha ki agar koi stri prasav ke dauran mare, to uske paanv me sui chubhoi jaati thin tatha uske shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dali jaati thi, taaki woh apne parivar ko dhoondhti phirti na rahe. Aisi manyataayein dikhati hain ki us samay mrityu tatha prem ko kaise samjha jaata tha tatha auraton ki maut ke aas-paas kitna bhay tatha andhvishwas tha. Exam point: Churail us stri ki aatma maani jaati thi jiski maut prasav ke samay hui ho; use shaant karne ke liye zameen me sui gaadi jaati thi; prasav me mari stri ke paanv me sui chubhone tatha shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dalne ki parampara thi.

qe: When a woman died in child-birth, what was thrown on her body to prevent her haunting her family?
qh: जब किसी स्त्री की प्रसव के समय मृत्यु होती थी, तो परिवार को न छूने के लिए उसके शरीर पर क्या डाला जाता था?
e: Gaon ke lok-vishwas me pret yaani aatmaon ka bahut mahatva tha tatha unhe shaant karne ke alag-alag upay pracharit the. Kurmi samuday me yah manyata thi ki jis stri ki mrityu prasav yaani bacche ke janm ke samay hui ho, woh Churail ban kar apne hi ghar-parivar ko pareshan karti hai. Isse bachne ke liye uske paanv me sui yaani needles chubhoi jaati thin tatha uske shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dali jaati thi. Vichaar yah tha ki aise upay se woh aatma ghar ki hadd me nahi rahegi tatha apne logon ko dhoondhne nahi aa sakegi. Isi ke saath in samudayon me Bandi Mai jaisi paropkari aatma ki puja bhi hoti thi, jise log shubh maante the. Exam point: prasav me mari stri ke paanv me sui chubhone tatha shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dalne ki parampara thi, taaki woh Churail ban kar parivar ko pareshan na kare; isi tarah Bandi Mai jaisi aatma ko paropkari maana jaata tha.

qe: Beside the revenue servants, who among the ordinary village officials performed important ceremonial functions at weddings and funerals?
qh: राजस्व-कर्मचारियों के अलावा गाँव के साधारण अधिकारियों में कौन विवाह तथा मृत्यु के अवसर पर महत्वपूर्ण रस्में निभाता था?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me revenue ke adhikariyon ke alava kuch aise karmchari the jo gaon ke rozana ke kaam tatha rasmon me zaruri the. Inme hajjam yaani nai ka naam alag tha, kyunki woh apne paramparagat kaam ke saath-saath vivah tatha mrityu jaisi rasmon me mahatvapurn bhumika nibhata tha; in maukon par uski upasthiti zaruri maani jaati thi. Baaki karmchariyon me badhai yaani carpenter tatha lohar shamil the, jo kheti ke auzaar yaani hal, khurpi tatha hathyar banane tatha unki marammat ke liye zaruri the; dhobi kapde dhota tha, tatha chamar ki patni gaon me dai yaani midwife ka kaam karti thi. Is tarah gaon ek aisi vyavastha thi jisme kai peshe apne kaam se bane hue the tatha lagbhag sabhi aavashyaktaon ki poori gaon me hi ho jaati thi. Exam point: vivah tatha mrityu ki rasmon me hajjam yaani nai ki upasthiti mahatvapurn maani jaati thi; badhai tatha lohar kheti ke auzaar banane tatha theek karne ke liye zaruri the; dhobi kapde dhota tha tatha dai ka kaam chamar ki patni karti thi.
